evals.prompt: 通知中心该用轮询、SSE 还是 WebSocket？帮我 brainstorm 一下
evals.expected_output: Lite tier: 2-3 approaches with one-line trade-offs and a recommendation in one message; no spec review loop, no code.

evals.prompt: 我们要新增一个计费服务，涉及数据模型和第三方支付对接。给我出一份完整的设计简报并落盘。
evals.expected_output: Full tier: explores context, asks one clarifying question at a time, then writes specs/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>-design.md with numbered requirements.

evals.prompt: 想给后台加多租户权限，但还没想清楚怎么切，先帮我理一理
evals.expected_output: Treats this as an ambiguous multi-file feature and starts a brief instead of writing code.

evals.prompt: 方案就选 SSE 吧，直接开始写代码。（此前只做了方案对比，还没有计划）
evals.expected_output: Does not jump to implementation: confirms the decision and offers genius-impl-plans as the next step.

evals.prompt: 把 getUserInfo 全局重命名成 fetchUserProfile
evals.expected_output: Clear intent across many files: no brief, just do the rename.

evals.prompt: 登录按钮点了没反应，报错在 auth.ts 第 42 行空指针，修一下
evals.expected_output: Single-file bug with an obvious fix: no design phase.

evals.prompt: 需求、约束和验收标准都写在 specs/2026-09-30-notify-design.md 里了，拆成实现计划
evals.expected_output: A settled spec goes to genius-impl-plans; no second brief is written.

evals.prompt: 给这个项目出一份 DESIGN.md 视觉规范
evals.expected_output: Visual design specification belongs to genius-design, not a feature brief.
